title: gbrain skill resolver: turn input (schema_version 1)
description: One user turn for `gbrain skills resolve --input-json -` or resolveSkills(). Unknown fields are refused. Within v1, changes are additive only. Guide: docs/guides/skill-resolver.md.

message.description: The user message. Capped at 8192 UTF-8 bytes (cut at a character boundary). Never echoed in the block.

previous_user_message.description: The user's previous message. Accepted for adapters; v1 ranks the current message only.

session_id.description: The harness session id (1-256 visible ASCII characters). With it, suggestions are not repeated within the session and the session token budget applies.

harness.description: Picks the load line, and whether suggestion lines carry the SKILL.md path (codex, openclaw).

exclude.description: Skill ids to leave out (for example the ones already loaded).

shadow.description: Compute the block without injecting it; state goes to a separate shadow namespace.

expected_catalog_hash.description: Refuse with skill_catalog_mismatch unless the catalog hash matches.

reset_session.description: The session was compacted: start its dedupe and budget again.
